# mxroute_reseller_package (Data Source)

Read one reseller package's limits. Null API limits and the unlimited quota flag become `unlimited`; `0` stays a distinct limit. Package quota is GB. Requires a plain reseller provider; impersonation aliases are rejected before any request.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_reseller_package" "starter" {
  name = "starter"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact package name.

### Read-Only

- `domain_pointers` (String) Domain pointer limit, or `unlimited`.
- `domains` (String) Domain limit, or `unlimited`.
- `email_accounts` (String) Usable customer mailbox limit, or `unlimited`. `0` permits no customer mailboxes and is distinct from `unlimited`; the system mailbox does not consume this allowance.
- `email_forwarders` (String) Forwarder limit, or `unlimited`.
- `quota_gb` (String) Disk quota in **GB**, or `unlimited`.
